extracted text: The paper discusses A356 aluminum alloy subjected to friction stir processing (FSP) under various parameters. The T6 heat treatment consists of solution treatment at 540°C for 4 hours followed by artificial aging at 165°C for 5 hours. After FSP, some samples received post-FSP artificial aging at 165°C for 5 hours. The paper reports that FSP broke up the coarse eutectic Si phase into 2.5-3.5 μm particles, resulted in dissolution of coarse Mg2Si particles, and eliminated porosity. For the optimal FSP parameters (2-pass FSP with rotation rate/travel speed of 1500/300), the tensile properties after aging (FSP+Age) reached YS of 253 MPa, UTS of 305 MPa, and elongation of 11%.
property mapping:
YS = Yield Strength (MPa)
